title: Finch Circle Training Questions — Expiry of the Original Note in a Reinstatement
content:
**Rule.** For a Finch Note reinstated on returned merchandise in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the reinstatement lapse share is 0.80 when the original note's issue entry on the membership shows an expiry date that has passed on the reinstatement date, 0.90 when that issue entry shows an expiry date falling 0 to 14 calendar days after the reinstatement date, and 1 otherwise.

**Which note is the original note?** The Finch Note redeemed on the returned unit; its issue entry is read from the membership's note history by its code.

**The original note expired last week. What share applies?** Its expiry date has passed on the reinstatement date: 0.80.

**It expires on the reinstatement date itself?** That is 0 days after: 0.90.

**It expires 14 days after the reinstatement date?** Still within 0 to 14 days: 0.90.

**15 days after?** 1.

**The membership's note history shows no issue entry for that code?** No issue entry shows an expiry date, so 1.

| Expiry date on the original note's issue entry, against the reinstatement date | Reinstatement lapse share |
|---|---|
| already passed | 0.80 |
| 0 to 14 calendar days after | 0.90 |
| 15 or more calendar days after, or no issue entry on the membership | 1 |
